messages:
incident-bot: Alert: Elevated p95 latency detected in EU-West inference cluster. Threshold: p95 > 800ms for 4m. Severity: P2. Paging @maya (oncall) and @sam (sre). Links: https://monitoring.redwood.internal/alerts/1857654322 :rotating_light:

maya (oncall): acked and joining. Seeing queue growth on gateway nodes euw-01..03. Dashboard shows batcher backlog rising and increased 429s to the model batcher.

sam (sre): context: autoscaler adjusted shard counts ~2h ago for medium-load models. No config commits since then. Rolling logs now.

automated-deploy-bot: Deploy event: model-serving/shard-autoscaler v1.9.2 -> v1.9.3 at 2026-07-26T14:50:00Z (deployer: ci).

oliver (eng): tail logs reveal kv-cache eviction spikes causing backpressure: ```[2026-07-26T15:03:12Z] ERROR kv-cache: eviction-rate=0.45, evict_burst=120, stall=true``` Also downstream batcher returns 429 when queue_len > 512.

maya (oncall): quick mitigation attempt A: enable conservative batching fallback on eu-west: `redwoodctl feature toggle set batching_fallback=conservative --region eu-west` 

carlos (pager): per runbook, if fallback doesn't stabilize in 4 minutes, drain heavy seq-length traffic (seq > 1024) to eu-central by policy split.

(2m) sam (sre): fallback toggle applied. p95 reduced from ~860ms -> ~700ms but queue still high. Error rate improved but not enough headroom.

leah (prod comms): drafting status update. Proposed short: "Investigating increased latency in EU-West. Intermittent 429s and higher p95 experienced by some customers. Mitigations in progress." Set next update in 20m.

raj (support): compiling list of accounts pinned to eu-west. We'll want to send targeted comms if we start draining traffic.

oliver (eng): initiating targeted traffic split: route heavy-prefixed requests (selector: avg_seq_len>800) 20% -> eu-central: `redwoodctl route add-split --from eu-west --to eu-central --percent 20 --match "avg_seq_len>800"` Applied.

maya (oncall): metrics: p95 now ~580ms for general traffic; heavy requests p95 still ~1s. Queues reduced 40%. Good interim.

incident-bot: Incident record created: incident/1857654322. Owner: maya (oncall). Severity P2. Handoff window +3h.

leah (prod comms): customer advisory draft (support-targeted):

"Hello — We detected a performance issue affecting inference in our EU-West region that may cause increased latency or transient 429s for some requests. We have implemented routing and batching mitigations which have reduced overall latency. If you are pinned to eu-west and rely on large-sequence requests, you may see some continued elevated latency while we monitor. No correctness issues observed. If you need assistance or would like us to route your traffic to another region, reply here or open a support ticket and reference incident 1857654322. Next update in 30 minutes. — Redwood Inference"

raj (support): will prepare targeted outbound to pinned customers + include link to status page. Recommend adding a dedicated support contact for affected enterprise accounts.

sam (sre): temporary mitigation seems stable. Action items for post-mitigation: collect batcher histograms, per-model cache pressure metrics, and autoscaler scaling event logs. Suspect kv-cache eviction policy interacts poorly with new autoscaler thresholds.

oliver (eng): prototype idea: adjust kv-cache soft-limit from 0.75 -> 0.85 on affected shards to reduce evictions; will test in staging and propose a hotfix if safe. Also consider lowering batcher rejection threshold from 512 -> 768 to reduce 429 churn.

maya (oncall): handoff note for night oncall at 18:00 UTC: Mitigations in place: conservative batching fallback enabled, heavy-seq traffic split 20% to eu-central, p95 stabilised ~550-650ms. Watch for kv-cache evictions, batcher 429s, autoscaler flaps. Escalation steps: increase split to 40% and enable temporary read-only mode for large prefixes if p95 > 800ms for 10m.

leah (prod comms): posting initial status page:

```incident: EU-West inference performance degradation
status: investigating
impact: Some inference requests in EU-West may experience elevated latency (p95 up to ~1s) and transient 429s.
mitigation: We have applied batching fallback and routed a portion of heavy traffic to EU-Central to reduce load.
next_update: 30 minutes
```

incident-bot: Status page updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1857654322 (state: investigating -> partial_degradation).

(10m) sam (sre): monitoring shows p95 steady ~620ms; no new 429 spikes. Throughput ~95% of baseline.

carlos (pager): logged follow-ups: [ ] capture kv-cache eviction traces, [ ] validate autoscaler config, [ ] add regression alert for batcher 429s at 3m, [ ] coordinate post-incident RCA owner.

leah (prod comms): prepared post-incident template for customers to be sent after RCA: short summary, timeline, impact, remediation steps, mitigation applied, and ETA for permanent fix.

maya (oncall): marking incident mitigated and lowering severity to P3. We'll monitor for 2h then create RCA ticket. Leaving handoff notes in incident doc for next shift. Good collaboration everyone. :thumbsup:
